crew.name: Marriott
crew.vibe: Everyone's punchbag. Lowest-stakes order in the game.

order.ticketText: Whatever's easiest. Yes, I'm still paying.

angry: Of course. Of course it is.

crew.name: Pitt
crew.vibe: Wants it pale. Fussy about any browning whatsoever. No toppings — they'd only distract.

order.ticketText: Pale. I said PALE. Barely toasted. Nothing on it.

greet: Keep it light. Lighter than that.
happy: Now THAT is a pale waffle.
meh: I can see grill marks. Concerning.
angry: This is BROWN. I asked for pale.
Are you trying to upset me?
walkout: I'll toast my own at home. Correctly.

crew.name: Nash
crew.vibe: Hyper-precise. Narrowest doneness band in the game. Tuts.

order.ticketText: Golden. Actual golden. One cherry, dead centre.

greet: I've modelled the optimal waffle. Match it.
meh: Outside one sigma but inside two.
angry: That is nowhere near the target.

crew.name: Marco
crew.vibe: Orders in invented words you decode from context.

order.ticketText: Un waffito, not too oscuro, con las fresas y the white fluffy. Medium syrupation.

greet: Hazme el desayuno, pero make it pretty.
You know what I want. Probably.
happy: This is a waffle of the highest calidad.
meh: Está... okay-ish. Regular tirando a meh.
angry: Esto no es lo que dije! I clearly said fresas!
walkout: I take my business elsewhere, amigo.

crew.name: James
crew.vibe: Kid at heart. Wants absurd amounts of everything.

order.ticketText: Everything. All of it. Then more syrup. Then a cherry I didn't ask about.

greet: Can you fit more on? Try.
happy: YES. This is a birthday every day.
meh: Where's the rest of the sprinkles?
angry: That's a SENSIBLE waffle. I hate it.

crew.name: Groves
crew.vibe: Shows up rough. Wants it burnt. Hardest regular.

order.ticketText: Cremate it. Bacon, chocolate, banana — don't ask. Drown it in syrup.

meh: Needs to be darker. And greasier.
angry: This is barely toasted. I asked for CHARCOAL.
